statusScope: Existing original RAW127/SVG127 cap3 acceptance threshold only, using saved native evidence and this same agent's d243 first visual observations.

clauses.requirement: Deterministic original bitmap contour tracing, not model recreation or semantic object/label addition, deletion or movement.
clauses.evidence: Historical page166-only native vectorize receipt binds the same RAW/SVG pair. d243 observed correspondence of main contours, channels and line groups, with no labels, neighboring text or new semantic objects in either crop.
clauses.conclusion: PASS within the previously observed crop scope; no new semantic review performed.

clauses.requirement: Render generated SVG using resvg; rendering failure or a returned raster shape unequal to source shape fails.
clauses.implementation: vectorize.py lines 115-125 calls _render_svg then checks got.shape == src.shape. _render_svg dispatches svg_raster.js; its matching frozen code uses @resvg/resvg-js with white background and no width argument on this path.
clauses.evidence: Saved native receipt exit0 and actual stdout report one figure passed. Current vectorize.py and svg_raster.js hashes match the historical author's initial/current code bindings. Native receipt after-snapshot SVG and PNG hashes match the inputs consumed by d243.
clauses.conclusion: PASS by read-only consumption of historical native command evidence, not by a new resvg execution.

clauses.requirement: Source and rendered ink are grayscale <128 (INK_THRESHOLD=128).
clauses.evidence: vectorize.py _ink uses this threshold; d243 saved pixel-comparison uses the same binary-ink definition.
clauses.conclusion: Applicable threshold confirmed; no new image thresholding performed.

clauses.requirement: EDGE_TOLERANCE=1; use the full 3x3 Chebyshev neighborhood around ink, not exact-pixel equality.
clauses.evidence: d243 recorded missing=7 and extra=0 under a radius1 Chebyshev neighborhood. Its native ink bounds have at least 12px margin; the implementation's np.roll wraparound versus clipped neighborhoods cannot change these counts at radius1.
clauses.conclusion: Applicable tolerance confirmed; supplemental saved counts are comparable to this formula, but are not resvg counts.

clauses.requirement: (missing+extra)/sourceInk <= MISMATCH_LIMIT=0.02; compare the unrounded ratio. sourceInk=0 is separately treated as ratio0 by the code.
clauses.evidence: d243 sourceInk=33399, so 7/33399=0.00020958711338662833, or 0.020958711338662832%, below 2%. Saved historical native output separately reports 0.015% and exit0.
clauses.conclusion: PASS within the existing threshold. Whole-image pixel count is not the contractual denominator.

clauses.requirement: Invert bitmap polarity for potrace and merge contours in one even-odd path so meaningful holes do not collapse into a solid flood.
clauses.evidence: Matching vectorize.py build_svg implements these requirements. d243 observed the roof's major white channels and separate line groups corresponding, with no black raster flood.
clauses.conclusion: No previously observed substantive collapse. This does not establish preservation of every small scanned white pit.

Retained verbatim in the unchanged d243 report: small scan pits/voids and tiny roughness are not all preserved. This remains a genuine fine-detail discrepancy, but is not itself a failure of the implemented cap3 gate.
